marcadores.explicacao_original: The middle ear houses the ear ossicles. The stapes is the ossicle that fits into the oval window in the wall separating the middle ear from the vestibule of the inner ear. Movement of the stapes results in change of pressure in the perilymph of the inner ear, thus triggering a response in the inner ear receptors.
